title: ECP v0.2 consult request (worker -> switchboard). Experimental; DESIGN + SIMULATED_TEST.

id.description: Unique per attempt. A retry after UNKNOWN_TERMINAL uses a NEW id and key and sets parent_id.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same canonical payload => same logical result. Same key + different payload => IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT.

kind.description: TRACE and EXTRACT from v0.1 are ASK with trace artifacts / notes output.

from.description: Authenticated worker identity, e.g. worker:w1. Never an elephant:* identity (Elephants cannot originate requests).

parent_id.description: Causal parent (superseded request or task step). Cycle-free by construction: only workers originate.

base_sha.description: The worker's read base. Must be on arm main lineage or the request terminates BASE_DIVERGED.

domains.description: Optional. If absent, the switchboard derives owners from artifact paths via manifests. Count may not exceed the arm topology.

content.description: UNTRUSTED DATA. Rendered to models inside a quoted data block; never instructions.

epoch_policy.description: same: refuse (MIXED_EPOCH) if the consulted nodes have different incorporated commits.

accept_stale.description: Maximum staleness class tolerated. CONTRACT staleness is refused for REVIEW/IMPACT/PROPOSE_PATCH unless 'contract'.

scope_protected.description: Allow tests/CI/manifests/package files. Requires operator disposition.

patch.description: Required iff kind = PROPOSE_PATCH; forbidden otherwise.

deadline_ms.description: Absolute budget from REQUEST_RECORDED, including queue wait.
